answer: Problem: sybil packs wander across open epochs recycling one stock fable as many identities. Mechanism: intake posts a voyage-bonded escrow of 19 POA that unlocks only after 5 established peers attest a live sample within 120 minutes, each peer burning 0.31 POA keyed to a voyage-lane hash of the epoch seed. Cost: every clone repeats the 19 POA voyage bond plus peer burns linearly. Verification: missing voyage-lane quorum or mismatched seed hash leaves the answer unattested. Failure: spam score 0 burns 55% of the voyage bond and freezes the key for 7 epochs.
